kjv: So shall he sprinkle many nations
mine: so shall he startle many nations
note: Hebrew yazzeh is normally the hiphil of nazah "sprinkle" (of priestly cleansing), but "sprinkle nations" is odd and the parallel (kings shut their mouths, v. 14 "appalled") suggests "startle"; the LXX has "many nations will marvel". The KJV's priestly reading is theologically significant.
